create_tiles_from_images: create a tile mosaic from a list of images with optional grid size and titles
crop_image_by_coordinates: crop an image using xyxy bounding box coordinates
resize_image_to_resolution: resize an image to a target width and height with optional aspect ratio preservation
save_images_to_directory: save multiple images to a directory using the ImageSink context manager
tint_image_with_color: tint an image with a solid color overlay at a given opacity
